hooks.name: Sync README API and MCP tools sections
hooks.description: When a .py file under api/ or mcp_server/ is saved, update only the "API" and "MCP tools" sections of README.md to reflect the current endpoints, tools, and an example response.

action.prompt:
A Python file under api/ or mcp_server/ was just saved. Update README.md so its "API" and "MCP tools" sections reflect the current code.

Scope and rules:
- Read the FastAPI app under api/ (routes, methods, paths, the /v1 prefix) and the FastMCP server under mcp_server/ (registered tools and their signatures). Base everything on the code as it exists now; do not invent endpoints or tools.
- Edit ONLY two sections of README.md:
  1. A section titled "## API" — list each HTTP endpoint (method + path) with a one-line description, and include one realistic example response (a JSON body from the contract, e.g. a BusTrustResponse or Health payload). Keep the example short.
  2. A section titled "## MCP tools" — list each MCP tool name with its parameters and a one-line description.
- If either section does not exist in README.md yet, create it by appending it to the end of the file. If it exists, replace only that section's body (everything from its "## " heading up to, but not including, the next "## " heading or end of file).
- NEVER modify any other part of README.md (title, tagline, or any other section). Preserve all surrounding content, headings, and ordering exactly.
- If api/ or mcp_server/ currently define no endpoints or tools, write "None yet." as that section's body rather than removing the section.
- Do not run commands or edit any file other than README.md.
